caption:
Swipe through. More people are Googling 'can't afford home' right now than ever in recorded history, more than during the 2008 financial crisis. 📊

Inside: why everyone thought 2008 was the worst housing crisis a generation would face, the Google Trends data that just set an all-time record, the shocking irony that home prices actually fell in 2008 while today's despair is higher, the four hard numbers behind the record, and what businesses can do with the demand being created right now.

The housing market never crashed this cycle. Prices held, despair compounded year after year, and now it has broken every historical record we have. The locked-out feeling is no longer temporary. It might just be the new normal.

Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what this means for yours.

Sources: Barchart on X, Google Trends
